measurement.time_and_RSS_scope: Native child wait4/process receipts; stream parsing excluded.

interpretation.interpretation: One diagnostic observation per role/case/policy. Corrected results and changed accounting are allowed. No statistical speedup, cross-cost work ratio, semantic equality or precision ordering is claimed.
interpretation.toy_cases: Both versions converge on all five toy cases. Loop has7states in both but B retains5Return/11Failure records versus A4Return/9Failure. Small raw payload review found all Returns length32 with input SlotRead/ADD and retained Ite histories; broad standard word observations remain. Extra records are not a proved precision improvement.
interpretation.unknown_callback: Both policies retain27states,16outcomes and3closed procedure-summary groups in both roles; source-dependent work remains separately reported.
interpretation.default_weth: Both detailed Incomplete:45states,44edges,38transfers,52outcomes and9Work frontiers. Both have input-bound AllInputStates Return/Revert/Failure attachments; those do not close CFG/SSA or prove gamma inclusion.
interpretation.default_usdc: Both detailed Incomplete with14Work frontiers. A107states/111edges/94transfers/42outcomes; B106/110/93/40. Failure records35->33 and7Revert each; the coverage attachment is separate. Smaller counts/time are not a like-for-like speedup.
interpretation.fixed_weth: Both Converged137states/160edges/244outcomes and one closed procedure-summary group. A484transfers/91diagnostics; B488/92. Observed3.765A vs3.942B seconds,350.5 vs352.9MiB RSS. No whole-effect equality or statistical conclusion.
interpretation.fixed_usdc: Both Incomplete231states/300edges/84outcomes and one open procedure-summary group. A13989transfers/40diagnostics/919Work frontiers; B13423/36/913Work+22SummaryWork. Observed95.946A vs105.092B seconds,1355.7 vs1257.6MiB RSS,624.5 vs525.5MiB JSON. This is a slower single B observation with different bookkeeping/coverage details, not a speedup claim or statistical regression proof.
interpretation.delivery: All 28strict streams valid. Six ORIGINAL64MiB whole-report consumers failed: both USDC at 2B, both WETH at 1T and both USDC at 1T. Their raw delivery flags/errors/native+harness+outer exits remain unchanged; a valid streaming supplement does not turn the original consumer into a pass. No external stop/NoReport occurred.
interpretation.validation_limits: The existing collector reads all records through EOF, checks JSON/schema/config/input/root-attachment shape/binding and unchanged per-value64MiB cap. It does not fully type-check native graph references, recompute all IDs/Keccak hashes, establish joint concrete inclusion, prove terminal gamma inclusion or compare every A/B effect. Wire16 is a reviewed source/interface witness, not a native JSON field. Native RSS/time exclude parser postprocessing; parser process RSS is not native RSS.
interpretation.original_vs_final_source: Runtime samples bind clean code freeze0ac. Final documentation-only delivery head and its fresh full gate are recorded in PR138; final producer/ELF equivalence is checked separately. Historical84sample archive is retained unchanged.
